issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Farm to use a List and initialize an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the solution implements the farm's collection as a Set (HashSet). This is a structural mismatch: students are instructed to use List/ArrayList (and tests may rely on list semantics and ordering), while the solution uses Set semantics which change duplicate handling and iteration order and thus may confuse or break expected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the specification by changing the Farm implementation to use List<Animal> and initialize it as an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor (e.g., private List<Animal> animals; this.animals = new ArrayList<>();). Alternatively, if Set semantics are intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify a Set/HashSet and explain the change.
